name: 4 Days workout
coachNotes: Personalized 4-Day training split prescribed by Coach Chinmay Jain (Updated 29 September 2026). Daily Target: 12,000 steps. Always begin every workout with the Dynamic Stretching Warm up and finish with the Cool Down routine.

days.dayName: Day 1/ Day 4: Upper Body (Chest, Back, Shoulders & Triceps)
days.focus: Upper Body Hypertrophy & Strength (Chest, Back, Shoulders, Triceps)

exercises.name: Dynamic Stretching Warm up (very starting)
exercises.notes: Daily dynamic mobility before starting resistance exercises.

exercises.name: Inclined Bench Press 30 degree
exercises.notes: 30-degree incline. Retract scapula, control the eccentric phase, press through upper pecs.

exercises.name: Lat pulley pull down
exercises.notes: Full stretch at top, pull bar down towards upper chest with elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbell Shouder Press
exercises.notes: Keep core tight, press dumbbells smoothly overhead without hyperextending lower back.

exercises.name: Bent over Barbell rows
exercises.notes: Hinge forward at 45 degrees, pull barbell to lower ribcage, squeeze lats and mid-back.

exercises.name: Resistance band/dumbell lateral raises
exercises.notes: Lead with elbows to parallel, slow 2-second negative.

exercises.name: Dumbell overhead extension
exercises.notes: Keep elbows pointing forward, emphasize the long head stretch behind head.

exercises.name: Dumbell Chest Flyes
exercises.notes: Slight elbow bend, wide controlled arc to stretch chest fibers.

exercises.name: Triceps rope bar pushdown
exercises.notes: Keep elbows fixed at sides, flare rope apart at bottom lockout.

exercises.name: back hyper extensions
exercises.notes: Hinge at hip, squeeze lower back and glutes at peak without over-arching neck.

exercises.name: Cool down (at the end)
exercises.notes: Static stretching and deep breathing to promote recovery.

days.dayName: Day 2/ Day 5: Lower Body & Abs (Whole Legs, Biceps, Glutes & Abs)
days.focus: Lower Body & Core Hypertrophy (Legs, Biceps, Glutes, Abs)

exercises.name: Dynamic Stretching Warm up (very starting)
exercises.notes: Daily dynamic mobility before leg and arm training.

exercises.name: Dumbell Goblet squats
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell tight against sternum, squat deep between hips with upright chest.

exercises.name: Biceps Curls (Barbell gym)
exercises.notes: Strict curls without momentum, full supination and peak squeeze.

exercises.name: Machine Leg extensions / Dumbell step ups
exercises.notes: 1-second peak squeeze at top of leg extension, controlled lowering.

exercises.name: Dumbell seated Hammer Curls
exercises.notes: Neutral palms-in grip to develop brachialis and forearm thickness.

exercises.name: Seated machine hamstring curls
exercises.notes: Curl heels firmly under, pause for a second and control return.

exercises.name: Dumbell Hip Thrusts
exercises.notes: Upper back on bench, drive hips upwards through heels, strong glute lock.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg raises (Gym)
exercises.notes: Brace core, curl pelvis up toward ribs without excessive swing.

exercises.name: Weighted Dumbell Crunches
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell securely on upper chest, exhale as you crunch up.

exercises.name: Cool down (at the end)
exercises.notes: Lower body hamstring, quad and glute static stretching.

days.dayName: Day 3: Functional Strength, Grip, Calves & Cardio
days.focus: Grip, Posterior Chain, Calves, Arms & Cardio Conditioning

exercises.name: Dynamic Stretching Warm up (very starting)
exercises.notes: Daily dynamic mobility routine before workout.

exercises.name: Deadhangs with scapula raise
exercises.notes: Hang from pull-up bar, depress and retract scapula with controlled reps.

exercises.name: Farmers Walk
exercises.notes: Hold heavy dumbbells, maintain upright proud posture with tight core.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Elevate toes on plate/step, full heel drop stretch and press up.

exercises.name: Push Ups
exercises.notes: Standard push-ups with locked core, chest to floor.

exercises.name: Dumbell Wrist curls
exercises.notes: Forearms on bench or knees, curl dumbbells upward using wrists.

exercises.name: High Cable Woodchopper Serratus
exercises.notes: Diagonal high-to-low pull engaging serratus anterior and obliques.

exercises.name: EZ bar reverse curls
exercises.notes: Overhand grip on EZ-bar, builds forearm and arm stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Wrist Twists Exercise
exercises.notes: Controlled wrist rotation pronation/supination.

exercises.name: Elliptical Cross Trainer Cardio
exercises.notes: 15-minute steady Zone 2 low-impact cardio session.

exercises.name: Cool down (at the end)
exercises.notes: Full body cool-down stretching and recovery.

days.dayName: Day 4: Rest with warm up and cool down
days.focus: Active Rest, Mobility, Joint Recovery & 12,000 Daily Steps

exercises.name: Dynamic Stretching Warm up (very starting)
exercises.notes: Start recovery day with light dynamic stretching.

exercises.name: Rest with warm up and cool down
exercises.notes: Rest day to let muscle tissue rebuild. Hit 12,000 steps with brisk walking.

exercises.name: Cool down (at the end)
exercises.notes: End-of-day static stretch to relieve any muscle tension.
